description: Fetch album profiles, released episode lists, channel and global rankings, full search results, or suggestions from iQIYI (iq.com).

albumIds.description: iQIYI album slugs, album URLs, play URLs or numeric album IDs. Examples: `genius-girlfriend-2026-28fzrln6il1`, `https://www.iq.com/album/fated-hearts-2025-d6iyehcx4p`, `https://www.iq.com/play/fated-hearts-episode-1-1ggw7a63yug`, `1324877168319701`.
albumIds.title: Album IDs or URLs (mode=byId)

channelId.description: Legacy channel ranking selector. 0 = Top, 1 = Movie, 2 = Series, 4 = Anime, 6 = Variety.
channelId.title: Channel (mode=trending, legacy)

includeDetails.description: Add score, exact release year, description, genres, age rating and cast roles to search results by reading each matching album profile.
includeDetails.title: Include album details in search (mode=searchTitles)

includeEpisodes.description: Include every currently released episode for album profiles and search results. Planned episode counts are always returned.
includeEpisodes.title: Include episode lists

language.description: Language for titles and metadata. These are the languages iQIYI currently returns for search results.
language.title: Metadata language (mode=searchTitles)

enumTitles: Album profile by ID or URL
mode.title: Mode

region.description: iQIYI serves a different catalogue per region. `intl` is the global catalogue; the others are regional catalogues.
region.title: Catalogue region (mode=searchTitles)

searchQueries.description: Title keywords or iq.com search URLs. Each query is searched in the selected region and language.
searchQueries.title: Search queries (mode=searchTitles)

searchQuery.description: Text used by the legacy search-box suggestion mode, e.g. `love`.
searchQuery.title: Suggestion query (mode=search)

title: iQIYI Album Profile & Channel Ranking Scraper Input
